parameters.name: STATTYPE
parameters.help: Elevation will compute shot, recv and cdp statics -- Refraction will copy shot and rcvr but compute cdp statics

choices.label: Elevation
choices.help: Compute Elevation statics to final datum.

choices.label: Refraction
choices.help: Input Refraction statics to final datum

parameters.name: FNL_ELEV
parameters.help: Enter final datum elevation constant value or PARAMETER from the SRF GEOMETRY DataBase. See help for other suggestions.

parameters.name: REPL_VEL
parameters.help: Enter replacement velocity constant value or PARAMETER from the SRF GEOMETRY DataBase. See help for other suggestions.

parameters.name: METHOD
parameters.prompt: Database math method for elevation statics
parameters.help: Select the method to use to compute the statics.  The different methods have slightly different computation algoriths

parameters.name: METHOD1
parameters.prompt: Database math method for refraction statics
parameters.help: Select the math_file to be used for working with the refraction statics.

parameters.name: W_VELOC
parameters.help: Enter groups of STATION-Weathering Velocity values. **SEE EXAMPLE!!!**

parameters.name: MATHFILE
parameters.prompt: Database math file for elevation statics
parameters.help: This specifies the name of the file that is used for database math to generate elevation statics.

parameters.name: MATHFIL1
parameters.prompt: Database math file for refraction statics
parameters.help: Specify the file name for the appropriate refraction static solution calculation.

parameters.name: NMO_METH
parameters.help: Select the method for creating the NMO statics.  See the help file for more explanation.

choices.label: Elevations
choices.help: Use the smoothed surface elevations (NMO datum).

choices.label: Mean Statics
choices.help: Use the smoothed mean of source and receiver statics of contributing traces in a CDP.

parameters.name: NSMOOTH
parameters.help: Enter the length of the smoother (in CDPs).  Use an odd number.

parameters.name: S_STATIC
parameters.help: Use Mouse Button 1 to select a SOURCE Statics file description (SDRM, SDLT, SGRM)from the SIN GEOMETRY database.

parameters.name: R_STATIC
parameters.help: Use Mouse Button 1 to select a RECEIVER Statics file description (RDRM, RDLT, RGRM)from the SRF GEOMETRY database.

parameters.name: DATUM1
parameters.help: Select datum to which the data will be referenced after running Apply Datum Statics.

choices.label: NMO DATUM
choices.help: Compute non-zero cdp mean (C_STATIC)- when statics are applied, the data will be referenced to Smooth Surface (N_DATUM)

choices.label: FINAL DATUM
choices.help: Compute zero cdp mean (C_STATIC)- when statics are applied, the data will be referenced to FINAL DATUM. NMO_DATUM = FINAL DATUM

parameters.name: DB_NUM
parameters.help: Enter a 2 characters (number) identifying the database output parameters as S_STATXX, R_STATXX, C_STATXX.
